name: styled-markdown
description: TextMate highlighting for .smd files, for the IDE's TextMate support. syntaxes/smd.tmLanguage.json is generated from the VS Code extension's grammars (scripts/bundle-grammar.mjs); syntaxes/markdown.tmLanguage.json is VS Code's Markdown grammar (MIT, see syntaxes/markdown.LICENSE.txt) under its own scope. The build copies language-configuration.json from extension/.
